from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single company's cash position extracted from a financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as stated in the filing")
    cash_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of Cash and Cash Equivalents reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    period_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date covered by the statement")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the cash line item and value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_records: list[CompanyCashRecord]
